Lantern Song
for the verse fixtures (2026)

[Verse 1]
I walked the long road home tonight
The lantern swinging in my hand (x2)

[Chorus]
Carry the light, carry the light
Over the hill and down to the sea
Carry the light, carry the light

[Verse 2]
The river kept its quiet word
The fields lay silver in the cold

[Chorus]

[Outro]
Carry the light
